name: A Kingdom Divided
description: Investigate the power struggle within Great Kourend and unravel the mystery behind the disappearance of the royal family.
startLocation: Martin Holt, entrance to Kourend Castle, Kingstown

name: A Night at the Theatre
description: Survive a second run through the Theatre of Blood for unique rewards, fighting all six bosses in sequence.

name: A Porcine of Interest
description: Ah, the Falador Farm - filled with cabbages, cows, and even a sleepy sheepdog. A peaceful place, where you can learn to churn butter, give a dog a bone, or purchase various Farming supplies. What was once a place of happiness, joy and wholesome dairy goods has of late become dominated by a vile presence. Each morning Sarah wakes to find her crops destroyed, her cows cowering, and her loyal sheepdog looking... sheepish. She's had enough, but she thinks she's got the culprit on the trot. Can you help her track down... A Porcine of Interest?
startLocation: Read the town notice board in Draynor Village, behind Fortunato's Wine Shop.

name: A Soul's Bane
description: Help a father rescue his son Tolna from a rift in the ground near Tolna's farm, fighting the monsters manifested from Tolna's tormented mind.

name: A Tail of Two Cats
description: Help Bob the cat rediscover his past life as a legendary hero while assisting Unferth with his missing cat.
startLocation: Bob the Cat (random location, found via Bob's Brilliant Axes, Burthorpe)

name: A Taste of Hope
description: Infiltrate the Theatre of Blood to rescue captured vampyre slaves and undermine the power of Lord Lowerniel Drakan.
startLocation: Garth, Ver Sinhaza, outside the Theatre of Blood

name: A Theatre of Blood
description: Assist the vampyres of Darkmeyer in preparing an entertainment venue — the Theatre of Blood — for their elite.

name: Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl
description: Complete the barcrawl set up by Alfred Grimhand to gain entry to the Barbarian Outpost.
startLocation: Guard at the Barbarian Outpost entrance, east of Seers' Village

name: Animal Magnetism
description: Help bury the restless dead by collecting a variety of bones and skulls scattered across Gielinor. Investigate a sinister force manipulating these undead creatures.
startLocation: Port Phasmatys, Barrows area, Ava's workshop

name: Another Slice of H.A.M.
description: Investigate HAM activity in the Dorgeshuun tunnels and prevent a plot to reignite the human-goblin conflict.

name: At First Light
description: Venture to the Mountains of Fire and help the Phoenix Guard investigate a mysterious threat rising in the volcanic peaks of Varlamore.

name: Barbarian Training
description: Learn ancient barbarian skills from Otto Godblessed, including barbarian fishing, firemaking, and herblore.

name: Bear Your Soul
description: Help the spirit of a bear by collecting the pieces of his soul from the Spirit Realm.
startLocation: Speak to the Odd Old Man near Paterdomus

name: Below Ice Mountain
description: Explore the ancient Camdozaal ruins beneath Ice Mountain and help a team of archaeologists uncover what lies within.
startLocation: Willow on the path south of Ice Mountain

name: Beneath Cursed Sands
description: Journey to the buried tombs beneath the Kharidian Desert and uncover an ancient secret buried for centuries.

name: Between a Rock...
description: Help the dwarven geologist Rowdy Reynolds uncover the secrets of the keldagrim granite mine and face a powerful golem.
startLocation: Dondakan the Dwarf, Keldagrim south-west mine

name: Big Chompy Bird Hunting
description: Learn to hunt the mighty chompy bird for Rantz the ogre, and earn the right to wear a chompy bird hat.

name: Biohazard
description: Follow up on the events of Plague City by smuggling plague samples out of West Ardougne for Elena.

name: Black Knights' Fortress
description: Infiltrate the Black Knights' Fortress and discover their secrets.
startLocation: Just north of Falador, outside the fortress

name: Bone Voyage
description: Help the Varrock Museum archaeologists set up a dig site on Fossil Island by chartering a boat and arranging supplies.

name: Cabin Fever
description: Join the pirate Bill Teach on his vessel and help repel an attack from the Customs and Excise Office using seafaring skills.
startLocation: Bill Teach, The Green Ghost inn, Port Phasmatys

name: Children of the Sun
description: Sail to a new land and encounter a mysterious civilisation that worships the sun, uncovering their ancient secrets.

name: Client of Kourend
description: Become a client of the Kourend Council by completing favours for each of the five Great Kourend houses.

name: Clock Tower
description: Help Brother Kojo fix his Clock Tower south of East Ardougne by finding four missing cogs.
startLocation: Brother Kojo, Clock Tower south of East Ardougne

name: Cold War
description: Help the penguins of the Penguin Intelligence Agency foil a secret penguin operation threatening Gielinor.

name: Contact!
description: Make contact with a high priest in the desert and complete a sacred mission.

name: Cook's Assistant
description: Help the cook in Lumbridge Castle by gathering ingredients for his cake.

name: Creature of Fenkenstrain
description: Assist Dr Fenkenstrain in his monstrous experiments by gathering body parts to construct a creature.
startLocation: Dr Fenkenstrain's Castle, north of Canifis

name: Current Affairs
description: Help Arhein get past some political red tape and unlock the current duck, a useful Sailing tool.

name: Curse of the Empty Lord
description: Discover the story of Sliske and his past by following the footsteps of a tormented Mahjarrat ghost through Gielinor.
startLocation: Speak to Viggora near the Wilderness Chaos Temple

name: Daddy's Home
description: Help Yanni Salika renovate his home in Shilo Village as a gift for his returning father.
startLocation: Speak to Yanni Salika in Shilo Village

name: Darkness of Hallowvale
description: Infiltrate Meiyerditch and work with the myreque to gather intelligence about Darkmeyer from within the vampyre city.
startLocation: Veliaf Hurtz, basement of Burgh de Rott inn

name: Death on the Isle
description: Investigate a mysterious string of deaths occurring on a remote island and uncover the killer\

name: Death Plateau
description: Help a Burthorpe guard investigate treasonous activity in the Imperial Guard — and find a safe passage through Death Plateau.

name: Death to the Dorgeshuun
description: Accompany Zanik into the surface world and protect her as she explores Lumbridge, while investigating a HAM plot.

name: Defender of Varrock
description: Help defend the city of Varrock from a zombie army raised by the Zamorakian Mahjarrat Zemouregal.

name: Demon Slayer
description: A mighty demon is being summoned to destroy the city of Varrock. You find out you are the one destined to stop him (or at least try).
startLocation: Speak to Aris in the tent on the western side of Varrock Square.

name: Desert Treasure I
description: Help the archaeologist uncover the secrets of the Ancient Pyramid and unlock Ancient Magicks.

name: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire
description: Find treasure in the fallen desert empire.

name: Devious Minds
description: Help a suspicious monk near the Paterdomus temple craft a special item — only to discover a sinister ulterior motive.

name: Doric's Quest
description: Help Doric the dwarf by gathering materials so he can make pickaxes, and earn access to his anvils.

name: Dragon Slayer I
description: Prove yourself a true champion. Kill the mighty dragon Elvarg of Crandor and earn the right to buy and wear the Rune platebody.

name: Dragon Slayer II
description: Confront the resurrected dragon Galvek and face the greatest dragonslaying challenge Gielinor has ever seen.

name: Dream Mentor
description: Help Cyrisus overcome his fears in the dream world and unlock new Lunar spells.

name: Druidic Ritual
description: Help the druids of Taibwo Taiboa island by performing a ritual during a sacred ceremony.

name: Dwarf Cannon
description: Help the dwarves by delivering a cannon to a friend in need.

name: Eadgar's Ruse
description: Help Eadgar, a druid in the Troll Stronghold, discover a cure for a troll curse.

name: Eagles' Peak
description: Investigate the disappearance of a naturalist\
startLocation: Eagle's Peak area (Charlie at Ardougne Zoo)

name: Elemental Workshop I
description: Discover an ancient workshop beneath Seers\
startLocation: Bookcase, house south-west of Seers' Village bank

name: Elemental Workshop II
description: Return to the elemental workshop and unlock the secrets of the mind element to craft an elemental mind helmet.

name: Enakhra's Lament
description: Enakhra, a Mahjarrat follower of Zamorak, seeks to release her trapped companion Akthanakos from an ancient pyramid.

name: Enlightened Journey
description: Learn the art of balloon travel from Auguste in Entrana and set up balloon routes across Gielinor.

name: Enter the Abyss
description: Help a Zamorakian mage infiltrate the Wizards\
startLocation: Speak to the Mage of Zamorak north of Edgeville

name: Ernest the Chicken
description: A farmer named Farmer Fred has lost his chicken, Ernest, a prized white chicken.

name: Ethically Acquired Antiquities
description: Work with the Varrock Museum to recover ancient artefacts from those who obtained them through dubious means.

name: Fairytale I - Growing Pains
description: Help Martin the Master Gardener investigate a blight killing the crops in Zanaris, tracing it back to the fairy godfather.
startLocation: Martin the Master Gardener, Draynor Village

name: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen
description: Travel through the fairy rings to cure the Fairy Queen and uncover the Fairy Godfather\

name: Family Crest
description: The Armours family has fallen on hard times. Gilandor Armours, the patriarch of this noble family, has grown old and is dying. His three sons have not inherited his competence. You must help the youngest son of the Armours family create the family crest so that it can be passed on with pride.

name: Family Pest
description: Help the Fitzharmon family deal with a pest infestation in their basement.
startLocation: Speak to Dimintheis in south-east Varrock

name: Fight Arena
description: Rescue the imprisoned Lady Servil from the gladiatorial arena of General Khazard.
startLocation: Lady Servil, north-west of East Ardougne

name: Fishing Contest
description: The dwarves guarding the White Wolf Mountain tunnel will only let you pass if you bring them a fishing trophy — first prize at the Hemenster fishing competition.
startLocation: Austri east of White Wolf Mountain, or Vestri to the west

name: Forgettable Tale...
description: Help the dwarves of Keldagrim recover a key ingredient for their special ale, navigating their bureaucracy along the way.

name: Garden of Tranquillity
description: Help Queen Ellamaria restore the royal garden of Varrock to its former glory by collecting rare plants from across Gielinor.

name: Gertrude's Cat
description: Help Gertrude find her lost cat Fluffs, who has gone missing somewhere near the Lumber Yard.

name: Getting Ahead
description: Help Gordon the farmer protect his sheep farm from a headless beast roaming the northern fields.

name: Ghosts Ahoy
description: Lay to rest the tormented ghosts of Ecto Island, still bound to the ruins of Port Phasmatys.

name: Goblin Diplomacy
description: Help negotiate peace between feuding goblin generals.

name: Grim Tales
description: Help Sylas the collector obtain three rare fairy tale items — a giant\
startLocation: Sylas, Taverley, just south of the house portal

name: Haunted Mine
description: Explore an abandoned mine in Morytania in search of a glowing crystal, but beware the darkness within.

name: Hazeel Cult
description: Choose sides in a conflict between the Hazeel cult and the Carnillean family — either help revive the demon Hazeel or stop the cultists.

name: Heroes' Quest
description: Prove your worth to join the Heroes Guild by completing dangerous challenges that test your skills and courage.

name: His Faithful Servants
description: Speak to the shades within the Haunted Mine and learn about their devotion to Zaros.
startLocation: Speak to the haunted mine entrance ghost

name: Holy Grail
description: Aid King Arthur and his knights in the sacred quest for the Holy Grail, guided by visions of Merlin.

name: Hopespear's Will
description: Assist Hopespear, a goblin spirit, in returning the remains of the goblin high priests to Yu'biusk, the ancestral goblin homeland.
startLocation: Hopespear, crypt of the Goblin Temple

name: Horror from the Deep
description: A horrifying creature has emerged from the deep. Help defeat it to protect the shores and unlock ancient barrow dungeons.

name: Icthlarin's Little Helper
description: Help the god Icthlarin retrieve his escaped soul for the Sophanem temple by journeying through the Kharidian Desert.

name: Imp Catcher
description: Help a wizard catch imps for an experiment and learn to summon allies.

name: In Aid of the Myreque
description: Help the Myreque resistance in Burgh de Rott survive the vampyre threat and establish a vital base of operations.
startLocation: Veliaf Hurtz, Myreque Hideout, below Canifis pub

name: In Search of Knowledge
description: Assist Brother Aimeri in uncovering the mysteries that lie in the Forthos Dungeon.
startLocation: Brother Aimeri, south-eastern end of Forthos Dungeon

name: In Search of the Myreque
description: Track down the secretive Myreque resistance group hidden in the swamps of Morytania.

name: Into the Tombs
description: Investigate the ancient tombs beneath the Kharidian Desert and uncover the secrets hidden within.
startLocation: Speak to Maisa in the Ruins of Unkah

name: Jungle Potion
description: Trufitus Shakaya of Tai Bwo Wannai needs five special jungle herbs collected to commune with his gods.

name: King's Ransom
description: Investigate the disappearance of the Camelot knights and unravel a conspiracy reaching to the heart of the kingdom.

name: Lair of Tarn Razorlor
description: Track down and defeat Tarn Razorlor, a deranged necromancer who has taken up residence in the Haunted Mine.
startLocation: Enter the Haunted Mine and navigate to Tarn\

name: Land of the Goblins
description: Help the goblins of Goblin Village discover their ancestral homeland beneath the sea by navigating goblin politics.

name: Learning the Ropes
description: Tutorial quest teaching the basics of Old School RuneScape.

name: Legends' Quest
description: Embark on the most legendary adventure in RuneScape — exploring the Kharazi Jungle to restore an ancient tablet.

name: Lost City
description: Find the legendary lost city of Zanaris, hidden somewhere in Lumbridge Swamp.
startLocation: Warrior, northwest corner of Lumbridge Swamp

name: Lunar Diplomacy
description: Broker peace between the Fremennik and the Moon Clan of Lunar Isle, unlocking the Lunar spellbook.

name: Mage Arena I
description: Prove your magical prowess in the Mage Arena deep in the Wilderness to earn a God Cape.
startLocation: Speak to Kolodion in the Mage Arena bank (level 56 Wilderness)

name: Mage Arena II
description: Return to the Mage Arena to face three powerful champions of the gods and earn an imbued God Cape.
startLocation: Speak to Kolodion in the Mage Arena bank (level 56 Wilderness)

name: Making Friends with My Arm
description: Help My Arm the troll build a rooftop farming patch on Death Plateau, navigating trolls and mountain dangers.

name: Making History
description: Investigate the history of Outpost and Ardougne by speaking to ghosts and finding lost records across Gielinor.

name: Meat and Greet
description: Help the Varrock Cook prepare a feast by gathering special meats from around Gielinor.
startLocation: Varrock Square, speak to the Cook

name: Merlin's Crystal
description: Rescue the wizard Merlin from a crystal prison in Camelot, trapped there by the dark witch Morgan Le Faye.

name: Misthalin Mystery
description: Investigate a series of murders occurring in an eerie mansion on the outskirts of Varrock.

name: Monkey Madness I
description: Help King Narnode Shareen investigate what happened to his 10th Squad, sent to guard the gnomes' shipyard on Ape Atoll.

name: Monkey Madness II
description: Return to Ape Atoll to confront Glough and his army of enhanced demonic gorillas threatening Gielinor.
startLocation: King Narnode Shareen, the Grand Tree

name: Monk's Friend
description: Help the monks of Ardougne monastery find their missing child oblate, who has gone to hide in the woods.
startLocation: Brother Omad, Monastery south of Ardougne

name: Mountain Daughter
description: Help a mountain tribe chieftain reconcile with his estranged daughter by fulfilling an ancient ritual to appease the lake spirits.

name: Mourning's End Part I
description: Infiltrate the Mourners headquarters in West Ardougne to uncover the sinister secret behind their mysterious activities.

name: Mourning's End Part II
description: Descend into the Temple of Light and navigate a series of deadly mirror puzzles to reach the Death Altar hidden within.

name: Murder Mystery
description: Solve the murder of Lord Sinclair in his mansion by gathering clues and identifying the culprit.

name: My Arm's Big Adventure
description: Help My Arm the troll learn to farm by taking him on a series of increasingly dangerous farming expeditions.

name: Nature Spirit
description: Follow up on Priest in Peril by entering Mort Myre and helping the nature spirit Filliman Tarlock achieve peace.

name: Observatory Quest
description: Help the Professor at the Observatory repair the telescope so he can resume his astronomical research.

name: Olaf's Quest
description: Help an old viking named Olaf Hradson complete his father\

name: One Small Favour
description: Help Aggie the witch with one small favour — which spirals into a chain of increasingly complicated tasks across Gielinor.

name: Pandemonium
description: Set sail on your first voyage aboard the Pandemonium and learn the basics of the Sailing skill.

name: Perilous Moons
description: Navigate the dangerous lunar cycles of Cam Torum and help its inhabitants survive the periodic waves of magical creatures.

name: Pirate's Treasure
description: Follow a series of clues from the pirate Redbeard Frank to find a buried treasure hidden somewhere on Karamja.

name: Plague City
description: Travel into the quarantined West Ardougne to rescue Elena, trapped by the plague that has devastated the city.

name: Priest in Peril
description: Rescue a priest who has been trapped in a cursed temple by dark forces.
startLocation: Morytania, near the entrance to the temple

name: Prince Ali Rescue
description: Rescue Prince Ali of Al Kharid from Lady Keli\

name: Prying Times
description: Help Steve Beanie recover some "pirate treasure" and unlock the crowbar, a useful Sailing tool.
startLocation: Speak to Steve Beanie on the Pandemonium.

name: Rag and Bone Man I
description: Collect the bones of various creatures across Gielinor for the Odd Old Man, who is assembling a strange collection.
startLocation: Odd Old Man, north of Varrock

name: Rag and Bone Man II
description: Collect a second set of unusual bones from more exotic creatures across Gielinor for the strange collector near the Wilderness.
startLocation: Odd Old Man, north of Varrock

name: Ratcatchers
description: Follow a trail of mischief as your cat helps track down rats — from a Varrock mansion to the sewers of Pollnivneach.

name: Recipe for Disaster
description: Break the magical freeze on the Lumbridge Cook and his banquet guests by gathering a series of exotic ingredients.

name: Recruitment Drive
description: Prove your worth to Sir Tiffy Cashien of the Temple Knights by passing a series of puzzling tests at their recruitment facility.
startLocation: Speak to Sir Amik Varze on the 3rd floor[US] of the White Knights' Castle's western tower in Falador

name: Regicide
description: Assassinate a tyrant king threatening the elf kingdom. A dangerous mission requiring cunning and combat prowess.

name: Romeo & Juliet
description: A tale of star-crossed lovers in Varrock.

name: Roving Elves
description: Help Islwyn and Eluned complete a task for the Elven Crystal and gain passage into the Elven Lands.

name: Royal Trouble
description: Investigate a threat to the kingdoms of Miscellania and Etceteria, and reunite the two squabbling rulers.

name: Rum Deal
description: Help the monks of Braindeath Island deal with a zombie plague threatening their famous rum operation.

name: Rune Mysteries
description: Discover the secrets of the rune essence mine and unlock the ability to craft your own runes at the altars.

name: Scorpion Catcher
description: Help the wizard Thormac recover his three scorpions, escaped from his tower and scattered across Gielinor.

name: Scrambled!
description: Help the Egg Shrine priest recover the lost eggs and restore the shrine.

name: Sea Slug
description: Investigate an attack on the Witchaven fishing platform, where its workers have fallen under the influence of sea slugs.

name: Secrets of the North
description: Investigate a brutal murder in the frozen north and uncover a conspiracy that could shake the foundations of Gielinor.

name: Shades of Mort'ton
description: Help restore the ruined village of Mort\

name: Shadow of the Storm
description: Confront the demonic Agrith-Naar summoned by the Dark Mage and prevent chaos from consuming the Kharid desert.
startLocation: Father Reen, south of Al Kharid

name: Shadows of Custodia
description: Investigate the mysterious shadows appearing in Custodia and help restore peace to the region.
startLocation: Speak to the Custodian in Lumbridge

name: Sheep Herder
description: Doctor Orbon in East Ardougne needs your help — plague-infected sheep have wandered into the city and must be rounded up and incinerated before they spread disease.
startLocation: Dr Orbon, East Ardougne church courtyard

name: Sheep Shearer
description: Shear 20 sheep for Fred the Farmer near Lumbridge and return the wool to earn a small reward.

name: Shield of Arrav
description: Reunite the two halves of the legendary Shield of Arrav by infiltrating one of Varrock\

name: Shilo Village
description: A foul mist and a plague of undead have overtaken Shilo Village. Delve into ancient Karamjan history to stop the queen of the dead and open the village to travellers.
startLocation: Mosol Rei, outside Shilo Village (south Karamja)

name: Sins of the Father
description: Confront the twisted dragonkin and end the Vyrewatch lord Damien Leucurte\

name: Skippy and the Mogres
description: Help Skippy near Mudskipper Point discover what is lurking beneath the water, and unlock access to Mogre hunting.
startLocation: Speak to Skippy near Mudskipper Point, south-west of Port Sarim

name: Sleeping Giants
description: Investigate a strange disturbance at the Giants Foundry and help awaken ancient sleeping giants from their slumber.

name: Song of the Elves
description: Unlock the gates of Prifddinas, the lost elven city, by breaking the curse placed upon it centuries ago.

name: Spirits of the Elid
description: Help the spirits of the river Elid restore water to the parched desert of the Kharidian.

name: Swan Song
description: Help the Piscatoris Fishing Colony defend itself against a merciless sea troll invasion.

name: Tai Bwo Wannai Trio
description: Reunite three brothers in the Tai Bwo Wannai jungle by completing a series of tasks for each of them.

name: Tears of Guthix
description: Seek out Juna the serpent deep within the Lumbridge Swamp Caves to collect Guthix\

name: Temple of the Eye
description: Help the Wizards Tower investigate a mysterious eye-shaped ruin and establish a link to a powerful new runecrafting altar.

name: The Ascent of Arceuus
description: Help the Arceuus Library by tracking down a thief who has stolen several valuable books and taken refuge in the caverns below.

name: The Corsair Curse
description: Help the corsair captain Arsen and his crew lift a mysterious curse that has befallen their hidden cove.

name: The Curse of Arrav
description: Battle the curse that has affected Arrav through the ages.

name: The Depths of Despair
description: Investigate the source of a disease afflicting the Port Piscarilius fishing industry.

name: The Dig Site
description: Assist the Varrock Museum archaeologists at their dig site east of Varrock to uncover ancient Zarosian artefacts.

name: The Enchanted Key
description: Use an enchanted key to locate buried treasure chests scattered across Misthalin and Asgarnia.
startLocation: Silver merchant, East Ardougne (reclaim enchanted key if lost)

name: The Eyes of Glouphrie
description: Investigate the gnome illusionist Glouphrie\

name: The Feud
description: Go undercover in Pollnivneach to mediate the violent feud between the Menaphite thugs and the Bandit gang.

name: The Final Dawn
description: Access to the Crypt of Tonali

name: The Forsaken Tower
description: Restore power to the Forsaken Tower in the Lovakengj house by solving its internal puzzles.

name: The Fremennik Exiles
description: Uncover a plot to disgrace the Fremennik people and bring justice to those who framed an innocent man.

name: The Fremennik Isles
description: Broker peace between the Fremennik and the Icefiends of Neitiznot and Jatizso.

name: The Fremennik Trials
description: Prove yourself worthy of becoming a Fremennik by completing a series of tests set by the Fremennik people.

name: The Frozen Door
description: Investigate a mysterious frozen door on Lunar Isle and discover what lies behind it.

name: The Garden of Death
description: Help restore a peculiar garden in Lovakengj by tending to its unusual and dangerous magical flora.

name: The General's Shadow
description: Help the spirit of a Zarosian general complete his unfinished business in the God Wars Dungeon.
startLocation: Speak to the shadowy figure near the God Wars Dungeon

name: The Giant Dwarf
description: Represent the Consortium as an ambassador to the giant dwarves and influence the political climate of Keldagrim.

name: The Golem
description: Deep in the desert, an ancient clay golem forever paces the ruins of Uzer. Uncover the secret of the lost city and put the golem to rest.
startLocation: Clay golem, Ruins of Uzer (east of Shantay Pass)

name: The Grand Tree
description: Investigate why the Grand Tree of the Tree Gnome Stronghold is dying, following a trail of treachery and deceit.
startLocation: King Narnode Shareen, Tree Gnome Stronghold

name: The Great Brain Robbery
description: Travel to the island of Mos Le'Harmless and uncover a mad scientist plot involving mind control and theft of consciousness. Stop the nefarious experiments.

name: The Hand in the Sand
description: Investigate the mystery of a severed hand found in Bert's sandpit at Yanille and expose the conspiracy behind it.
startLocation: Bert, Yanille, near the sand pit

name: The Heart of Darkness
description: Venture into the corrupted heart of a dark power at sea and confront the evil lurking within its depths.

name: The Ides of Milk
description: Embark on a peculiar Sailing voyage to resolve a strange dispute involving a missing cargo of milk.

name: The Knight's Sword
description: Help Sir Vyvin\

name: The Lost Tribe
description: Investigate a hole that has opened in the Lumbridge Castle cellar and make peace with the tribe living below.

name: The Path of Glouphrie
description: Delve deeper into Glouphrie\

name: The Queen of Thieves
description: Infiltrate the criminal underworld of Great Kourend\
startLocation: Tomas Lawry, Port Piscarilius, Great Kourend

name: The Red Reef
description: Help Floopa overcome her injury while investigating the dealings of the Red Reef Trading Company, a potential new threat to the Tortugan way of life.

name: The Restless Ghost
description: Help a restless ghost in Lumbridge\

name: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute
description: Help the frogs of the Kourend Woodland negotiate an end to their heated lily pad labour dispute.

name: The Slug Menace
description: Investigate the sea slug infestation spreading from Witchaven and stop it from reaching Kandarin\

name: Tale of the Righteous
description: Learn the tale of a righteous knight from ancient Kourend and help settle unfinished business. A spiritual story of honor and redemption in the mystical lands.

name: Temple of Ikov
description: Retrieve the Staff of Armadyl from the Temple of Ikov for Lucien — or betray him and destroy it instead.

name: The Tourist Trap
description: Go undercover in the Desert Mining Company\

name: Throne of Miscellania
description: A king has gone missing on the island of Miscellania. Investigate the disappearance, challenge for leadership, and restore order to the troubled kingdom.

name: Tower of Life
description: Investigate a mysterious tower in Taverley where a mad alchemist is performing strange experiments on human bodies. Help put an end to the dark rituals.
startLocation: Effigy, Tower of Life, east of Ardougne Monastery

name: Tree Gnome Village
description: Protect the Tree Gnome village by defeating invaders and helping the gnomes prepare their defenses.
startLocation: Tree Gnome Village, northwest of Ardougne

name: Tribal Totem
description: Lord Handelmort of Ardougne has acquired a sacred totem belonging to Karamja's Rantuki tribe. Help Kangai Mau reclaim it.
startLocation: Kangai Mau, The Shrimp and Parrot restaurant, Brimhaven

name: Troll Romance
description: Help Ug the troll find a mate by completing a dangerous task to win the heart of Aga.

name: Troll Stronghold
description: Rescue two captured soldiers held within the Troll Stronghold on Death Plateau.

name: Troubled Tortugans
description: Help the tortugan pirates of The Pandemonium recover their buried plunder.
startLocation: Talk to Floopa, an Injured Tortugan, on a Remote Island in the Unquiet Ocean.

name: Twilight's Promise
description: Fulfill an ancient promise made at twilight by resolving a long-standing conflict between two forgotten peoples at sea.

name: Underground Pass
description: Travel through a dangerous underground passage to reach the land of the elves, avoiding traps and dark magic.

name: Vale Totems
description: Restore the ancient totems in the Elven Vale to unlock a new teleport destination within Tirannwn.

name: Vampyre Slayer
description: Help a citizen by slaying a vampire that has been terrorizing the area.
startLocation: St. Bride temple, south of Morytania

name: Wanted!
description: A wanted man is on the loose. Can you track him down?

name: Watchtower
description: Help the Watchtower wizards near Yanille reclaim a stolen crystal from the ogres below.

name: Waterfall Quest
description: Help a tribesperson recover a sacred totem from a mysterious waterfall.

name: What Lies Below
description: A travelling trader has been stranded south of Varrock after his cart was attacked by local outlaws. He needs the help of a hero to recover his lost documents, but that's not all... The Varrock Palace Secret Guard (VPSG) are on the trail of treacherous dealings with the Monks of Zamorak. Will you be able to help the VPSG and uncover what lies below?

name: While Guthix Sleeps
description: Investigate the resurgent Mahjarrat threat while Guthix slumbers, culminating in a confrontation at the Stone of Jas.

name: Witch's Potion
description: Help the witch by collecting ingredients for her potion in exchange for an artifact.
startLocation: Witch house, south of Draynor Manor

name: Witch's House
